verdict.summary_en: Incoming inspection of CMP-GAM-010 (die-cast statue 'The Getaway') from SUP-0018 Pune Diecast Works, goods receipt 5000413063 of 2026-11-17, PO 4500318727. 9 defective in a sample of 125 against accept 3 / reject 4 (AQL 1.0, level II), so the lot of 5,600 fails. The defects are paint defects on the base. The lot was booked to unrestricted stock, and blocking has been requested.
red_flags: Lot failed AQL: 9 defective in a sample of 125, against an accept number of 3 and a reject number of 4.

The lot of 5,600 was booked to 'unrestricted' stock by receiving because the supplier is listed as active, even though it failed inspection. It is not blocked yet; blocking has only been requested from Supplier Quality.
Use is allowed only under a concession signed by Supplier Quality and the Category Lead.
Defect type: paint runs and thin coverage on the edges of the base. Dimensions, weight and packaging are OK.
observations: Typed, clean digital document with no handwriting, stamps, or signatures.
Inspector named in the footer as Schulz P.; no signature is visible.
